:::{#exr-hessian}
#### Hessian

Derive the [Hessian](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-hessian).
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-hessian}

With one parameter,
the Hessian is the second derivative of the log-likelihood,
which is the derivative of the score from @exr-cyclone-score-fn:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\ell''(\rate; \vx)
&= \deriv{\rate}\paren{\frac{n \bar x}{\rate} - n}
&& \text{(differentiate the score)}\\
&= n \bar x \deriv{\rate}\frac{1}{\rate} - \deriv{\rate} n
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= -\frac{n \bar x}{\rate^2}
&& \text{($\tfrac{d}{d\rate}\rate^{-1} = -\rate^{-2}$; $n$ is constant)}
\end{aligned}
$$

For the cyclone data, $\ell''(\rate; \vx) = -`r sumx`/\rate^2$.
:::
